description: Synthetic 1-group step oracle: hand-built params plus closed-form values.
provenance: Params are hand-picked (beta=0.0065, lambda=0.08 1/s, Lambda=1e-4 s). initial_rate is the algebraic identity n0*rho/Lambda from E1+E2. prompt_jump_factor is beta/(beta-rho) from E4. analytic_since_step lists the two-exponential closed form n(t) = A*exp(s1*t) + B*exp(s2*t) with s1=0.03546455778928248, s2=-45.115464557789274, A=1.4421733025937287, B=-0.44217330259372867 (roots of s^2 + [lambda + (beta-rho)/Lambda] s - lambda*rho/Lambda = 0), evaluated in float64; t is seconds since the step.
